summary.heading: Order summary
summary.whatsappMessage: Hi TechWorld, I have a question about order {code}

items.question: Where do I find my order code?
items.answer: It is shown on the confirmation screen immediately after checkout and in the WhatsApp message we send you. It is short, uppercase, and unique to your order.

items.question: Why do you ask for my phone digits too?
items.answer: An order code on its own is short enough to guess. Asking for the last four digits of your checkout phone number means nobody but you can pull up your order details.

items.question: My status has not changed in two days. Is something wrong?
items.answer: Status updates land when an order physically moves, and weekends and public holidays create quiet gaps. If your order has been in the same state for more than three working days, message us with the code and we will look into it.

items.question: The status says shipped but nobody has called.
items.answer: Couriers typically call on the delivery day rather than the dispatch day. If you are past the estimate for your governorate, send us your order code and we will chase the courier directly.

items.question: Can I still change my address or cancel?
items.answer: Up until the order reaches the packed stage, yes. Message us with your order code as early as you can — once the parcel is with the courier we can no longer redirect it.
